comments.author: OutlandishnessGood45
comments.body:
**Luma Developer Update** We just pushed a new live build focused on account creation, home building polish, and interior readability. **What changed:**

* New players can now create an account from the title screen.
* Account creation collects username, email, password, and password confirmation.
* Email is now saved with the player account so we can support account recovery later.
* Login/logout flow was cleaned up so logging out returns players to the login card.
* Wall building now supports click-and-drag placement with a confirmation step.
* Wall placement shows a proper ghost preview using the actual wall art.
* Wall building now shows how many wall pieces are available in your bag.
* Newly built walls now drop in with a small build animation.
* Door placement and removal should feel more reliable, including from outside the room.
* Room interiors now read much better when walking inside.
* Roofs now use wood plank tiles instead of a flat dark overlay.
* Roofs fade away when entering the room.
* Roof reveal behavior now matches the wall reveal style.
* Other rooms’ roofs and unrelated doorway tiles now hide while you are inside a room.
* Wall reveal masking was improved so it only triggers when the player is actually behind/overlapping the wall area.
* The master development guide was updated with this building/interior polish pass.

This update should make account setup, building rooms, placing walls, adding doors, and walking around interiors feel much smoother and easier to read. If you test this build, please report any issues with:

* account creation
* login/logout
* wall placement
* door placement/removal
* walking through doorways
* roof visibility
* player visibility behind walls
* rooms that look wrong from certain angles

Screenshots or short clips help a lot. Thank you for testing Luma
